responsibility: This header defines the key working data structures used by the RTL if-conversion engine. ce_if_block summarizes the CFG shape and instruction counts of candidate IF-THEN/ELSE regions for conditional execution, while noce_if_info carries the operands, blocks, costs, and canonicalization state used by the noce branchless-conversion routines. It is the internal interface that organizes analysis and transformation state for ifcvt.cc.
same_name_distinction: Provides the internal data structures ce_if_block and noce_if_info that organize candidate CFG and operand state for the RTL if-conversion engine. The source file contains the actual analysis, transformation logic, and pass entry points.
